blocks.summary: Wikipedia’s operator says a bad AI copyright ruling could threaten the open web. The Wikimedia Foundation is staking out a middle ground in a group of landmark AI copyright cases, pushing courts to legally protect large language models (LLMs) training on copyrighted work - but not chatbots regurgitating that work to users.  An overly black-and-white ruling, it says, could either deprive Wikipedians of useful AI-based tools or endanger the open web.
